description: Ahlem Houcine and co-authors publish a cross-sector energy-system modelling dataset for Tunisia’s transition to 2050. The native description is empty, but the original title establishes the infrastructure subject and the two ZIP descriptors identify input data and hourly data. The record explicitly identifies an earlier deposit as a previous version and links a supporting publication. The two archives are retained as one national energy-system input resource; the earlier version does not receive a separate record. Zenodo provides free access under CC BY 4.0. The metadata does not specify represented sectors, scenario start year, regional units, measured variables or the vintage of the hourly profiles. Its sparse documentation limits interpretation. The related GENeSYS-MOD family record provides collection context. No archive or article body was opened and neither input quality nor simulation results were checked.
